title: bayarkit demo
tagline: One interface for Malaysian payment gateways. An order is marked paid only when the gateway itself confirms it.
simulatedNote: Every gateway here is fake and runs inside this demo server. No money moves and no real keys are used.

errors.amount: Enter an amount in ringgit, for example 1.00.
errors.minimum: The minimum for this gateway is RM{min}.
errors.order: Demo orders live in memory and are gone when the server restarts. Start a new one from the demo home page.
errors.busy: Too many people are trying it at once. Please try again shortly.
errors.notFound: There is nothing at this address. Start again from the demo home page.

pay.heading: Pay {amount}

pay.label: Pay
pay.hint: The gateway records the payment, then sends a signed callback.

decline.label: Don't pay, but a callback arrives anyway
decline.hint: A correctly signed callback arrives, but the gateway has no payment on record (a replay or a leaked key).

forge.label: Pay, but the callback is forged
forge.hint: Someone altered the callback's signature on the way.

swap.label: Don't pay, but send another order's paid callback
swap.hint: A cheaper order at the same shop was really paid. Its genuine, signed callback is sent to this order instead.

pay.title: Pay the demo shop

order.heading: Order {reference}

steps.received: The shop's server received the callback
steps.query: The gateway was asked again (the callback is not trusted)
steps.match: Reference, amount and currency match the order

reasons.ok: The order is marked paid because the gateway itself confirmed a payment for this reference and amount.
reasons.invalid_signature: Refused: invalid signature. This callback did not come from the gateway, so the gateway was not even asked.
reasons.not_paid: Refused: the signature is valid, but the gateway says it is not paid. A valid callback alone is not enough.
reasons.mismatch: Refused: the gateway says paid, but the reference or amount does not match this order.
reasons.gateway_error: Refused for now: the gateway could not be reached. Try again when the callback is retried.

home.heading: Paid only when the gateway itself confirms it.
home.checksHeading: Every callback goes through four checks

checks.received: A callback is only a claim. Anyone can send one to your shop.
checks.signature: Signed with the gateway's key? A forged callback stops here.
checks.query: bayarkit asks the gateway directly whether this payment was made.
checks.match: The payment must be for this order's reference and amount, not a cheaper one.

home.verdict: Only after all four does the order count as paid. Try each scenario to watch one fail.
home.lead: One interface for Malaysian payment gateways, in TypeScript and PHP. Choose a gateway, pay a fake bill, and see what bayarkit checks before it believes a callback.
